name: v4.4.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(watchlist): pass scheduled topics as literal research text by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1514
* fix(mcp): honor save=false for local research artifacts by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1515
* fix(github): scope research evidence to public repositories by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1517
* fix(skill): isolate Python helper commands by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1513
* fix(x): scope live authentication checks to eligible research by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1523
* fix(packaging): count files in the skill archive by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1520
* fix(watchlist): persist structured comparison results by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1519
* fix(html): protect synthesis drafts through publishing by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1518
* fix(watchlist): redact webhook credentials from output by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1522
* fix(setup): honor effective browser consent by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1528
* fix(cache): keep newer research during freshness updates by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1521
* fix(perplexity): honor the Deep Research deadline by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1516
* fix(watchlist): preserve budget accounting after topic removal by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1524
* fix(research): preserve strict-mode reports for consumers by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1530
* fix(privacy): protect research databases and briefing archives by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1526
* fix(research): bound final transcript and ranking work by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1525
* fix(preflight): reflect caller policy in research forecasts by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1529
* fix(hosted): reject unsupported research options before submission by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1527
* fix(privacy): keep private drill context out of published briefs by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1531
* fix(cache): bind follow-ups to their report generation by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1532
* chore(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.8.0 to 0.8.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1456
* chore(deps): bump github/codeql-action/upload-sarif from 4.39.1 to 4.39.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1457
* docs: add Turkish README translation by @alkank in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1511
* chore(deps): bump trufflesecurity/trufflehog from 3.99.7 to 3.99.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1455
* feat: proxy mode bills paid lanes to one API key; hosted clarify and error fixes by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1536
* feat: person runs for working professionals (--employer, --linkedin, --email) by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1538
* chore(release): bump version to 4.4.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1539

## New Contributors
* @alkank made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1511

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/compare/v4.3.2...v4.4.0
